changelog: LSA Leads now show a call count (N/7) plus who called last and when — the goal is 7 attempts before a lead is marked Lost/Unqualified
"No Answer" now keeps a lead in the queue for the next attempt instead of removing it; a lead is auto-marked Unqualified once it reaches 7 attempts (Booked/Unqualified still finish it immediately)
Click the phone number under a lead's name to open CTM's call history filtered to that number (works in the list and the review card)
